title: Children's Loungewear Recalled by Warm Biscuit Bedding Due to Violation of Federal Flammability Standards
summary: The loungewear garments fail to meet children's sleepwear federal flammability standards which require sleepwear, including loungewear, to be either snug-fitting or flame resistant. Units: About 9,500.

title: Outdoor Playset Gliders Recalled by Backyard Play Systems Due to Fall Hazard; Repair Kit Provided
summary: The retaining rings used to secure the gliders to the playset can become loose or detached, posing a fall hazard to children. Units: About 1800.

title: Hair Dryers Recalled by Vintage International Due to Electrocution Hazard
summary: The hair dryers are not equipped with an immersion protection device to prevent electrocution if the hair dryer falls into water. Immersion protection devices, which prevent electrocution, are required by industry safety standards for all electric hand-held hair dryers. Units: About 2,300.

title: Bicycles Recalled by REI Due to Fork Failure
summary: The fork can separate from the steerer tube which can cause the rider to lose control, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 260.

title: Bugaboo Recalls Strollers Due to Risk of Brake Failure
summary: One or both sides of the brakes can fail, causing a stroller to unexpectedly roll away on an incline. This can pose a risk of injury to the child occupant. Units: About 22,500.

title: Body Boards Recalled by JGR Copa Due to Violation of Lead Paint Standard
summary: The green surface coating of the screened logo "Big Lizard™ body boards" on the underside of the body board contains excessive levels of lead, violating the federal lead paint standard. Units: About 900.

title: SmartSpark Energy Systems Recalls Battery Equalizers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The recalled equalizers can overheat, posing a fire and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 800.

title: Campbell Hausfeld Recalls Air Compressors Due to Fire Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Wal-Mart
summary: The compressor's thermal overload, which shuts the unit off when it overheats, can fail. This can lead to overheating, melting of parts and a risk of fire. Units: About 16,000.

title: Children's Necklace and Bracelet Sets Recalled by D&D Distributing-Wholesale Due To Choking Hazard
summary: Small parts can detach from the necklace and bracelet when the elastic string breaks, posing a choking hazard to young children. Units: About 29,000.

title: Macy's Recalls Children's Hooded Sweatshirts Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: The sweatshirts have a drawstring sewn at the base of the hood which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 33,000.

title: Wagner Spray Tech Recalls Heat Guns Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: An electrical component failure inside the heat guns can cause them to continue to produce heat after the power switch is turned off. This can melt the heat gun's plastic exterior, causing a burn if the heat gun is touched and ignite nearby combustibles, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 30

title: Laceration Hazard Prompts Recall by Starbucks of Coffee Grinders; Made by Tsann Kuen
summary: The grinder can fail to turn off or can turn on unexpectedly, posing a laceration hazard to consumers. Units: About 530,000.

title: Viking Range Corporation Recalls Built-In Refrigerators Due to Injury Hazard; Doors Can Detach
summary: The refrigerator's doors can detach, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 45,326.

title: W.P. Appliances Inc. Recalls Wolfgang Puck Toaster Oven/Toasters
summary: The toaster oven can remain "on" after the toast pops up, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 7,040.

title: Six Reported Deaths Prompt Urgent Re-announcement of Blair Recall of Women’s Chenille Robes
summary: The robes fail to meet federal flammability requirements and present a risk of serious burns to consumers if they are exposed to an open flame. Units: 162000.

title: Children's Hooded Sweatshirts with Drawstrings Recalled by Winter Bee Due To Strangulation Hazard
summary: The jackets have a drawstring through the hood, which can pose a strangulation hazard to children. Units: About 80,000.

title: LaJobi Recalls Babi Italia Pinehurst and Bonavita Hudson Drop Side Cribs; Risk of Entrapment and Suffocation
summary: The lower spring pins on the footboard and headboard can pop out of the tracks located on the drop side causing the drop side to detach from the crib. When the drop side detaches, it creates a hazardous gap between the drop side and the crib mattress in which infants and toddlers can become entrappe

title: LaJobi Recalls Bonavita "Cabana" Drop Side Cribs Due To Entrapment and Strangulation Hazards
summary: The wooden crib slats can detach or break creating a gap, which can pose an entrapment and strangulation hazard to infants and toddlers. Units: About 2,000.

title: Big Muddy Motor Sports Recalls Generators Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The 220-volt receptacle can fail to produce power correctly and cause power surges that can damage appliances. This poses a risk of fire and possible injury to consumers. Units: About 450.

title: DEWALT Recalls Framing Nailers Due to Serious Injury Hazard
summary: The bump action trigger on the framing nailers could have been incorrectly assembled during production, which would allow the nailer to eject a fastener unexpectedly or cause the trigger lock-off not to function. This can pose a serious injury hazard to the user or bystander. Units: About 9,000.

title: Violation of Federal Mattress Flammability Standard Prompts Recall by Loyal Bedding of Mattress Sets
summary: The mattresses sets fail to meet the mandatory federal open flame standard for mattresses, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,700.

title: Applica Consumer Products Inc. Recalls Black & Decker Spacemaker Coffeemakers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The brew basket can shift out of alignment allowing hot water to overflow. This poses a scalding and burn hazard to consumers. Units: About 584,000.

title: Crane Plumbing Recalls Bath Tubs With A Whirlpool Due to Entrapment and Drowning Hazards
summary: The drain covers in the tubs can entangle a bather's hair in the openings, causing the bather's head to be held under water, which can result in drowning. Units: About 5,500.

title: Diving Wings With Defective Inner Bladders Recalled by Poseidon Due to Drowning Hazard
summary: The inner bladder located inside the diving wing can break, causing the wing to fail to operate as a floating/buoyancy device. This poses a drowning hazard to divers. Units: About 300.

title: Loaded Boards Recalls Orangatang Skateboard Wheels; Blow-outs Pose Risk of Injury to Riders
summary: The recalled skateboard wheel's core can shear and blow-out causing the wheel to separate from the skateboard truck's axle and bearings. This poses a risk of serious injury to riders. Units: About 1,200 sets.
